firstContext: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Gilberto opens the pantry wide: 7× Foraged food, 1× Foraged food. Ivan eat until the fire burns low. Nobody says what this cost — everybody knows, and winter is listening. auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 6 · Forage 14 · Craft 6 · Talk 18 · Explore 42 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ivy Wang and Marcus Webb ascended through doors you built: relay; relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Ivy Wang and Ethan Hunt and Marcus Webb ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.

ladderLines.line: ✨ CAPSTONE: Seed Vault. Every seed you have ever pocketed, kept dry and dreaming. It weighs almost nothing. Almost. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
